code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with lymphopenia, mild thrombocytopenia, elevated creatinine, ferritin, CRP, INR, and monocytes, as well as low glucose. These findings suggest acute systemic inflammation, possible infection, and impaired oxygenation, with evidence of mild renal dysfunction. The pattern may be seen in severe infection (e.g., viral pneumonia), sepsis, or systemic inflammatory response; clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
